A '''PlantBoy Advance''' is an {{Epic}} [[Mutation]].

== Obtaining ==
A '''PlantBoy Advance''' can grow in the [[Greenhouse]] if there are {{Item|Snoozling|amount=6}} and {{Item|Thunderling|amount=6}} within {{Green|1}} block of a {{Green|2x2}} area of farmland.

While growing, a '''PlantBoy Advance''' does not need water and has {{Green|12}} {{Dark Green|Growth Stages}}. When placed near another crop, it increases yield by {{Green|20%}}.

In order to harvest a '''PlantBoy Advance''', the player needs to collect {{Green|8}} apples in a game of Snake. If the player fails the minigame they may repeat it again immediately with no penalty.

== Crop Drops ==
When harvested, '''PlantBoy Advance''' also drops {{Item|Moonflower|amount=4600}}, {{Item|Sunflower|amount=4600}}, {{Item|Wheat|amount=4600}}, and {{Skill XP|36800 Farming}}.

== Usage ==
=== Crop Analyzer ===
A '''PlantBoy Advance''' can be analyzed in the [[Crop Analyzer]] for {{c|700k}}. When analyzed, it grants {{Copper|350}}. The first time analyzing a '''PlantBoy Advance''' grants an additional {{Copper|1,250}}.

=== Mutations ===
'''PlantBoy Advances''' are used to create an {{Item|All-in Aloe}}.

== Trivia ==
* The minigame is almost identical to Snake on the [[Abiphones]], save for the {{Green|8}} apple target.
* The '''PlantBoy Advance''' is a reference to the [[w:Game Boy Advance|Game Boy Advance]].
